A.note: Most photographic of the four. The rock has real rocky texture and scrub, and the sea, lighting and haze look natural. The runway, stadium and warehouses are all readable. Two small fires and smoke add story. Slight AI softness in the foreground and the mid-ground clutter.

B.note: Oversaturated, game-like colours. The rock is a smooth green-and-brown blob. The sea is a flat, saturated blue. The foreground terminal is a white, untextured block, and the grey ground is a flat colour field. It looks like a city-builder game.

C.note: Slightly better than B. The rock has more texture and there are paths on the hill, and the clouds and the sea are more varied. The foreground is still a flat grey colour field, the white block building is untextured, and the whole frame still reads as a game map.

D.note: Uniform orange-beige haze over everything. The ground is a flat tan colour field, so the runway and roads are barely readable. The city has lost its colour and detail and looks like a clay model. The foreground structures are confusing.

why: A is the only frame where the ground, rock, water and buildings read as a real place. B and C look like a city-builder game, and D is washed out by a flat tan haze.
top_fix_for_best: Clean up the foreground and mid-ground. Replace the soft, blurry buildings with sharper, varied rooftops and add texture and markings to the apron and roads. Keep the fires and smoke but make them a clearer focal point.
